name: Dead Bug Press

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Sahrmann Movement System Impairment Core Protocol

steps: Lie on your back with your arms pointing toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees directly over your hips.
Gently press your lower back flat into the mat by engaging your deep abdominal muscles.
Place your right palm firmly against your right thigh, applying isometric pressure between your hand and knee.
While maintaining that pressure, slowly extend your left arm overhead and your left leg straight out hovering just above the floor.
Return the extended limbs to the starting position, switch the hand-to-knee press to the opposite side, and repeat.
coaching_cues: Never allow your lower back to arch off the floor; only lower your leg as far as you can control your spine.
Maintain steady, calm breathing—do not hold your breath.
Focus on the deep bracing sensation behind your navel.
